name: TLS Server Certificate Issued by Compromised eMudhra Intermediate
description: Detects a presented TLS server leaf certificate whose issuer common name is one of the six compromised eMudhra TLS intermediates. Uses standard ECS TLS fields and covers both direct and Sectigo AAA chain paths because the leaf issuer is the same. This rule observes certificate use; it does not assert that the client accepted the chain.
query: network where tls.server.x509.issuer.common_name in ("EM DV TLS CA - G3B", "EM OV TLS CA - G3B", "EM EV TLS CA - G3B", "EM DV TLS CA - G3C", "EM OV TLS CA - G3C", "EM EV TLS CA - G3C")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator
false_positives: Historically legitimate eMudhra-issued TLS services and controlled certificate research. Confirm capture time, destination, and chain validation separately.

name: Authenticode File Issued by Compromised eMudhra Code-Signing CA
description: Detects signed files whose leaf signing certificate was issued by either compromised eMudhra code-signing intermediate. file.x509.issuer.common_name is standard ECS; the direct and AAA cross-signed variants share these issuer names. A match identifies certificate use, not necessarily a trusted signature.
query: file where file.code_signature.exists == true and file.x509.issuer.common_name in ("EM OV CS CA - G3B", "EM OV CS CA - G3C")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator
false_positives: Historically legitimate eMudhra-signed software and malware research collections. Review signature timestamp and file provenance.

name: Valid Trusted Authenticode Signature Using Compromised eMudhra CA
description: Detects a valid signature with an actively validated trusted chain whose leaf signer was issued by a compromised code-signing CA. ECS file.code_signature.valid and trusted must only be populated by a source that performed those checks; absence of these fields is not a rejection.
query: file where file.code_signature.exists == true and file.code_signature.valid == true and file.code_signature.trusted == true and file.x509.issuer.common_name in ("EM OV CS CA - G3B", "EM OV CS CA - G3C")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator
false_positives: Properly timestamped legacy software that local trust policy intentionally continues to accept; controlled security validation.

name: Exact Compromised eMudhra Certificate or SPKI Observed
description: Matches all 16 compromised intermediate DER SHA-256 fingerprints or any of eight compromised DER SPKI SHA-256 values. Telemetry prerequisite: normalized events with custom certificate.usage, certificate.sha256 and certificate.spki_sha256 fields, one per chain certificate. These custom fields are required because standard ECS hashes describe the presented leaf, not every intermediate. SPKI matches also catch newly forged certificates using the same compromised keys.
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator
false_positives: Historical legitimate certificates and certificate research collections. Alert on any match but deduplicate by host and fingerprint.

name: Accepted TLS or Authenticode Chain Using Compromised eMudhra Key
description: Detects explicit chain acceptance involving any of eight compromised public keys. Telemetry prerequisite: custom normalized certificate events with certificate.chain_accepted set only after actual TLS or Authenticode trust validation. Certificate presence, tls.established, or a network connection alone must never populate this acceptance flag.
query: any where certificate.usage in ("tls", "code-signing") and certificate.chain_accepted == true and certificate.spki_sha256 in ("EBED6475C2C2D80FCB199F3FE8DD6E6B3CE60B77EB15D4E42C3DEC0C6F5B5105", "43BFFA19D6EF651451F6841E019931E96F6F2EAEFF28AB4B6F1CE4576DE2717B", "E0254C7FCDC265E2F0F8A428DABB75AB4AE039B4872D62F5EE57F0877D5A8A41", "49DD353DC2B919A3770645117D0E60C16115E7D1BC259EEFE734B00EA434FE5F", "63ECEFEE431D49523BC1136C4E72D0206A477086CAF606CD5CF025686C109CF8", "5C0660A2B164910D8FF589C18E14552E9E0EC237DCEFE2CB736D41A4811F81A0", "EC4FFA1AD0AC88081314B7AAFFEF6A91F97CD57291BB5BA686C5415F5EB4F6B6", "92C063D67E8F14DB71D288E11266FFDAF69CBF115F7BAB14F3BC2F68D25E0E30")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator
false_positives: Deliberately vulnerable validation systems and properly timestamped legacy Authenticode files. Alert immediately and triage the validator and host context.
